Coffee

What you get at Siblings

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Coffee and matcha

Guests describe the coffee as rich, balanced and never bitter, and the matcha as smooth and creamy. One praises the iced latte.

Sandwiches and baking

7 reviews mention the sandwiches. Guests name lountza halloumi, loukanikopita, muffins, cookies and peanut butter bars.

Takeaway and delivery

The Instagram profile lists takeaway and delivery. One guest notes that most things come wrapped in paper and paper bags.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Atmosphere

11 Google reviews mention the atmosphere. One guest says it feels like dropping by a friend's home.

Polite staff

6 reviews mention the polite staff, 3 the baristas, 2 the warm welcome.

Coming back

One visitor kept returning for the rest of the stay. Another has ordered every day for two weeks.

On Antiopis

At Antiopis 2 in Larnaca, with a covered terrace. Open Monday to Friday 6:00-17:30, Saturday 6:00-15:30, Sunday closed. Takeaway and delivery, phone 96 721172.

What guests say

Three of 87 Google reviews, 84 of them with five stars.

“The atmosphere is warm, open, and wonderfully familiar — it genuinely feels like dropping by a friend’s home.”
